lines: Every forecast a commercial team relies on, passes through software.
And that software is rarely tested, the way the business actually uses it.
One silent error... and a launch plan is built on numbers that are simply wrong.
This is ForecastIQ, our agentic short-term forecasting tool. And this is QAgent, the AI that tests it.
Give it the product requirements, and in about thirty seconds, it writes a test plan, in plain business language.
No scripts. No engineers clicking through screens.
Then it tests the real application, the way a person would.
Signing in. Uploading brand data. Choosing a method.
And checking every number against the requirements.
A blank file is rejected by the server, yet the screen still shows a forecast, built on a hundred and forty four rows that never existed.
An export button that silently does nothing.
A flat growth curve, still ranked best fit.
Ten journeys. Sixty five steps. Ten minutes, for about a dollar fifty.
And every run can be replayed exactly, at no model cost.
Built once, reusable across every product team at Chryselys.
QAgent. Test it the way your customers will use it.
